crc32fast 1.5.5 from crates.io, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream source commit 8a93d2a70c00ab3e72beda42014b18fad8e496ea.
Published archive SHA-256 2b929dd2a135771f40afabd1073f85eed59c800b7c61901e5c254270497dad64.

Workbench replaces the SIMD raw-pointer loads with checked byte slices and typed
register construction. Dynamic dispatch remains responsible for CPU features.
The wider x86 kernels explicitly zero-extend the initial CRC into their high
lanes. The local crate uses Workbench's Rust 1.90 minimum.
